primary: Unweighted average of both schedules, orientations, two objects and two directional surface laws. Fixed v34 model index 0 for all cells. All other fits sensitivity only.
negative_control: isotropic on each object, sign + placeholder only; excluded from primary mean
timing: One warm-up per schedule and method then three randomized interleaved repeats each; 8 x 128 deployment worlds per call, one sensor realization. Full CPU+GPU wall time bracketed by CUDA synchronize.
Brier: 8 x 128 worlds/block/sign, 32 paired sensor realizations per world, identical chosen action, predictions paired by world/draw
selector: v34 ActionConditionedDetector + posterior predictive K256 with exact fixed 4 and 13 probes per 128 worlds
decoder: v34 Engine(pair,*alpha), using true proxy correlation hyperparameters in both arms, no target contact law, identity or sign supplied
physical_time: excluded; both methods use the same four paid calibration probes and deployment action
